source: Six learner attempts saved as one batch
lessonTheme: Commands with reasons and primero/luego action sequences
summary: Feminine negative publish command used mismatched lo with correct lista; corrected to la. Then correct masculine negative-reason and affirmative-reason instructions. Introduced primero/luego: action order correct twice, with probalo stem relapse first. Focused retry and full sequence retry retained ue; primero transposition and accents supplied.

observations.outcome: Correct transfer to el logo with both lo and listo; negative command, reason and both negatives correct. Está accent supplied.
Correct switch to affirmative attached object and positive readiness reason. Written accents supplied. Tutor then introduced Primero revísalo; luego pruébalo and translated primero/luego.
Correct primero/luego sequence and affirmative object attachment, but probar command stem reverted to probalo. Tutor supplied prueba + lo → pruébalo. Accents also supplied.
Correct full prueba + lo stem/attachment after the immediately preceding model, with accent supplied. Supported retry, not delayed recall.

Correct action sequence and retained ue in pruébalo after focused retry. Priemro letter transposition and command accents supplied. Earlier primero was correctly spelled; do not infer a persistent spelling deficit.
